title: Welcome the room
stageDirections: Wait for the chatter to dip. Speak a little slower than you think you need to.
spokenText: Welcome in. Thank you for coming. I will walk us through the night, introduce the music, and keep the games moving. If you need anything, catch me between segments. Have a wonderful time.
announcement: Welcome. The host will start the evening shortly.
hostNotes: Copy this onto an event before you tailor the names. The library original stays as it is.
